== Pirate Treasure Map == {{Consumable |picdesc = Pirate Treasure Map.png |acquired = Quest reward |location = Three-Barrel Cove (heroic) |turnin = |minlevel = 1 |bind = {{Bind|No}} |effect = Before opening a chest, use this map, and for the next 15 seconds you will get a +1 bonus to the quality of random [[loot]] in chests that you open. |durability = |material = |hardness = |cost = 100 pp |weight = 0.01 lbs |description = |notes =
:* The Pirate Treasure Map, the 3 items from the {{Named item sets|Corsair's Cunning}} set, the 4 'Scoundrel's type' weapons and {{Item|Brine Shaman's Staff}} have a chance of appearing in the end reward list of any of the [[Three-Barrel Cove (heroic)]] quests, except [[Guard Duty]]. Every third completion you will receive a complete list. :* After changes introduced in [[Update_46_Patch_2_Release_Notes|Update 46 Patch 2]] and the following fixes, items that previously affected the level of loot, only affect the roll you make while determining the quality of loot. Getting +1 to the roll of 1d100 isn't changing the outcome much, so this item is almost useless. :* This item only affects the [[loot]] for the player who has the effect when they open the chest. It does not affect the quality of loot for anyone else. |Category1 = Three-Barrel Cove (heroic) reward items }}
